test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentences in correct order to make a meaningful sentence

P. upon verification of biometric credentials Q. the disbursal of welfare benefits R. was initiated through direct bank transfer S. in all rural and semi-urban blocks
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. **QRSP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about the disbursal of welfare benefits and its associated process.
 
• The logical sequence begins with **(Q)**, "the disbursal of welfare benefits," as it introduces the main subject of the sentence.
 
• **(R)**, "was initiated through direct bank transfer," follows as it explains how the disbursal was carried out.
 
• **(S)**, "in all rural and semi-urban blocks," provides the location where the process was implemented.
 
• **(P)**, "upon verification of biometric credentials," concludes the sentence by describing the condition under which the disbursal occurs.

Therefore, the correct answer is **QRSP.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (QPRS):** This option places "upon verification of biometric credentials" too early, which disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2 (QSRP):** This option places the location "in all rural and semi-urban blocks" before the explanation of the process, which makes the sentence less coherent.
 
• **Option 4 (QPSR):** This option places "upon verification of biometric credentials" before "in all rural and semi-urban blocks," creating an illogical sentence structure.
